summary: Propagates flag bits through a scene-graph hierarchy. ORs flag a2 into the current node flag field (this+0x3C), and when a3 is non-zero ORs flag a3 into the head child flag field (+0x14) of the child-list structure read at this+0x204 and into every child reached through the +0x10 next pointers. Recurses with a4=1 when the this+0x44 pointer is non-null, then walks up to the parent pointer (this+0x4C) while a4 is non-zero.

local_names.a2: flag bits applied to the node itself
local_names.a3: flag bits applied to the children
local_names.a4: walk-up control flag (becomes 1 after the first upward step)
local_names.v6: child-list structure pointer read from this[129] (offset 0x204)
local_names.i: linked-list cursor over children via +0x10 next pointers
